/**
 * Given an escaped folder uri, return the path to folder in the user profile
 * directory.
 *
 * @param aFolderURI Escaped uri of folder we want the path to, without the
 * scheme
 * @param[out] aPathString result path string
 * @param aScheme scheme of the uri
 * @param[optional] aIsNewsFolder is this a news folder?
 */
nsresult NS_MsgCreatePathStringFromFolderURI(const char* aFolderURI,

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The helper header still documents an aScheme parameter that is absent from its signature, while implementation comments describe conversion back to a native charset although the result is nsString. Recommend updating both comments to the current escaped-URI, UTF-16 result and aIsNewsFolder roles. This is a scoped manual documentation proposal; it does not show that the conversion code itself is wrong. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Align folder-path helper documentation with the current signature
